We had such a wonderful experience celebrating our little one’s 1st birthday here! ❤️
The food was excellent, the ambience was beautiful, and the hosts were absolutely amazing—so cheerful, welcoming, and helpful throughout the celebration. They made us feel completely comfortable and ensured everything went smoothly, which made the day even more special for us.
The place is quite spacious and can comfortably accommodate around 60–70 people, making it a great choice for birthdays, family gatherings, and other celebrations. The ambience is lovely, with several beautiful and photogenic spots that made our pictures even more memorable. 📸✨
We genuinely had the most fun and memorable time celebrating this special milestone here. A big thank you to Shreyas for making our little one’s 1st birthday so special!
Would definitely recommend this place to friends and family, and we’ll surely be visiting again!
